house.title: House
house.description: Fund house (entity suffixes such as -FPI / -ODI / PVT LTD stripped)

event_type.title: Event Type
event_type.description: The stock's event label for the session

DealPrintRow.title: DealPrintRow
DealPrintRow.description: One collapsed print of the deal session (Today).

net_ex_prop_cr.title: Net Ex Prop Cr
net_ex_prop_cr.description: Net excluding PROP desks (drives events and ADV ratio)

vwap_vs_cmp_pct.title: Vwap Vs Cmp Pct
vwap_vs_cmp_pct.description: Close on as_of vs buy VWAP (else VWAP), %

net_10s.title: Net 10S
net_10s.description: Net ex-PROP Rs Cr on each of the last 10 sessions (dates in meta.context.net_10s_dates); NULL = no deal

deal_days.title: Deal Days
deal_days.description: Sessions in the window with any collapsed print

flow_net_cr.title: Flow Net Cr
flow_net_cr.description: Net ex-PROP on accumulate / fresh / distribute sessions only

net_by_session.title: Net By Session
net_by_session.description: Flow net per window session (dates in meta.context.window_dates); 0 = transfer/churn, NULL = no deal

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: quarantined | transfer | churn | conviction | fresh | distribution

DealWindowRow.title: DealWindowRow
DealWindowRow.description: One stock over the last N deal sessions (repeated deals, Play tiers, churn, transfers).

data_warning.title: Data Warning
data_warning.description: Unexplained price gap inside a metric window; those metrics are served NULL

queues.title: Queues
queues.description: Daily Desk queues the stock is in on as_of

rank_n.title: Rank N
rank_n.description: Groups ranked at this level and floor that session

delivery_accumulation.title: Delivery Accumulation
delivery_accumulation.description: (delivery value on up days - on down days) / delivery value over 10 sessions, % (-100..100)

acc_day_members_pct.title: Acc Day Members Pct
acc_day_members_pct.description: % of members with an accumulation day today

top1_turnover_share_pct.title: Top1 Turnover Share Pct
top1_turnover_share_pct.description: Largest member's share of group turnover, %

concentration_flag.title: Concentration Flag
concentration_flag.description: Top member >= 50% of group turnover (>= 3 members)

flow_up_days_10.title: Flow Up Days 10
flow_up_days_10.description: Sessions of the last 10 with turnover_share_delta > 0

rs_line_60.title: Rs Line 60
rs_line_60.description: Equal-weight group index / MidSml400, last 60 sessions, rebased to 100

legacy_rotation_state.title: Legacy Rotation State
legacy_rotation_state.description: Legacy sector_rotation label (not an RRG quadrant)

GroupStudyRow.title: GroupStudyRow
GroupStudyRow.description: Big movers by taxonomy level (evidence engine, spec §7.6).
